cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Remember Me Correctly
cards.instruction: Create small tests of whether someone remembers your preferences, stories, or shared history.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before you take the tea through, which cup is mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you just take one? Everyone's waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Twelve years of breakfast together. Which one have I always used?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The blue one. Your name's underneath.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Correct, but turn it upright. How much milk? I haven't written that on the handle.

mechanism: A runs precise tea-service questions as small tests of B remembered preferences, correcting a label-assisted answer into an unlabelled follow-up.
confusable: D81 asks history valued; D83 tests whether B remembers actual preferences or shared details.
comparison: Holiday alternative supplies a memory cue and multiple choice; tea alternative removes written aid and changes to milk preference.
seedUse: Twelve-year breakfast, blue named cup and milk question derive from D83-a; S03 adds exact test condition and serving-order correction.
